description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle that adapts Claude Code Game Studios (Donchitos, MIT) to dsh. It ships the studio workflow as 78 skills (start, next-step, prototype, design-system, design-review, create-architecture, dev-story, gate-check, sprint-plan, qa-plan, release-checklist, team-* and others), 49 agent role briefs meant to be handed to a subagent, the studio corpus (agent roster, director gates, engine and genre references, rules, shell helpers, the CLAUDE.md entry document and repo docs), and four tools. ccgs_init scaffolds a game project: it copies the corpus into .claude/, writes project.yaml, creates design/, docs/, tests/, production/ and assets/, and adds an AGENTS.md entry point. ccgs_state reports a project without writing: project.yaml keys, the resolved project.stage, and which design, docs, production and test artifacts exist. ccgs_role lists and reads role briefs. ccgs_doc lists, reads or searches the bundled corpus. The skills register through the dsh skills service and appear as bundled skills. The package is not published to npm, so it is catalogued browse-only; install by cloning the repository and adding the folder as a plugin, or with its github: spec.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code Game Studios（Donchitos，MIT）适配到 dsh 的 bundle：以 78 个技能提供上游的工作室流程（start、next-step、prototype、design-system、design-review、create-architecture、dev-story、gate-check、sprint-plan、qa-plan、release-checklist、team-* 等），附 49 份可直接交给子代理的角色简报、工作室语料（角色名册、总监门禁、引擎与类型参考、规则、shell 辅助脚本、CLAUDE.md 入口文档与仓库文档）以及四个工具。ccgs_init 为新游戏项目搭脚手架：把语料复制到 .claude/、写入 project.yaml、建立 design/、docs/、tests/、production/、assets/ 目录并生成 AGENTS.md 入口。ccgs_state 只读报告项目状态：project.yaml 键值、解析后的 project.stage，以及 design、docs、production、tests 下实际存在的制品。ccgs_role 列出并读取角色简报。ccgs_doc 列出、读取或检索内置语料。技能通过 dsh 的 skills 服务注册，以 bundled 来源出现在技能目录中。未发布到 npm，因此以浏览模式收录；安装方式是克隆仓库后把目录作为插件添加，或使用其 github: 规格。
